name: fierce-plugins
description: Internal plugin marketplace for Fierce Staffing Services and Consulting LLC. To install: Customize > Plugins > Browse > Personal > fierce-plugins. To update: remove the installed plugin, then reinstall it fresh from this same marketplace entry (Cowork does not support in-place updates for personal marketplaces yet).
